About the Fellowship

The Fulbright Sweden Scholar Program sends Swedish researchers and lecturers to US institutions for lecturing and research stays under the bilateral Fulbright agreement. Each year's call, with its closing date and discipline-specific awards, is published on the Fulbright Sweden site.

OpportunityFulbright Sweden Scholar Program
HostFulbright Sweden
LocationStockholm (host institutions in the USA), Sweden
Study LevelPostdoctoral, PhD
FundingPartially Funded
StipendSEK 50,000 grant + SEK 15,000 one-time travel allowance

ApplyOfficial application page ↗

The Fulbright Sweden Scholar Program sends Swedish researchers and lecturers to US institutions for lecturing and research stays under the bilateral Fulbright agreement. Each year's call, with its closing date and discipline-specific awards, is published on the Fulbright Sweden site.

Programme Highlights

  • Prestigious bilateral exchange for Swedish academics going to the USA
  • Award variants across disciplines and career stages
  • J-1 visa sponsorship under the Fulbright framework
  • Alumni network spanning Swedish academia

Who Should Apply

Researchers and lecturers affiliated with Swedish institutions planning US stays; specific awards set their own seniority and citizenship requirements.

Funding and Costs

Fulbright grant covering living stipend, travel and insurance components; host-institution salary arrangements vary by award. Confirm the exact funding package on the official page before applying.

Deadline and How to Apply

Review the Scholar Program page for the current call, note the closing date, and prepare the Fulbright application materials it lists. Key deadline information: Annual call — the closing date for the next cycle is published on the Fulbright Sweden programme page.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About Fulbright Sweden

The Fulbright Commission in Sweden administers the US-Sweden Fulbright exchange, including scholar programs that fund Swedish academics for research and lecturing in the United States.

Official website: https://www.fulbright.se

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Annual call - see official page - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
